title: Frost & Silver standalone wage-food budget: retained computational rerun
status_basis: game-change-review: 'reproduced' requires a rerun from the recorded inputs by someone other than the author. Only the author has rerun this package; no such rerun has been recorded yet.

model.kind: standalone household budget, not the classroom game engine
model.repository_snapshot_note: Repository snapshot (the merge of PR #23), not the commit that introduced the model.
model.game_path_not_applicable: This model never loads or executes projects/02/index.html.

run.quantiles: statistics.quantiles(values, n=20), default exclusive method; positions 0 and 18
run.randomness: CPython random.Random (MT19937), model lhs() with shuffle and uniform jitter; parameter insertion order matters
run.pairing: One identical six-parameter draw is evaluated in each case. No case consumes random draws.

prior_predictions_scope: Only the quantitative part of each pre-registered prediction is encoded. P2's qualitative clause ('only with many paid weeks, low costs and high kcal per real') is not encoded; see the package README.

original_predictions.reason_if_not_met: Compulsory service lowered household food in fewer than 95% of draws.

original_predictions.interpretation: '10-35% of draws' read as an inclusive interval on the positive share.
original_predictions.reason_if_not_met: The hired positive share is outside the predeclared 10-35% interval.
Mixed work raised household food in 10% or more of draws.
No positive break-even food price exists at the midpoint parameters: worker costs exceed wages there.

context_documents_policy: Pinned by commit and Git blob, never hashed in the working tree: these files are living repository documents (pre-registrations take appended deviations; LICENSE.md takes a row per game).
analysis_type: retrospective computational rerun after the earlier results were read; no new confirmatory test
blind_test: No. Committing the inputs before the run adds no evidential weight: the model is deterministic and its results were published in the 19 November report before this package existed.
historical_validation: not performed; inherited source readings, assumptions and limitations are unchanged
preservation: Versioned Git package; no independent scholarly archive or DOI has been established.
